memory_candidates: CS5Canonical.lean lives inside `namespace Cslib.Logic.Modal`, where Basic.lean's `scoped infix:30 " \u2192 " => Proposition.imp` shadows the core function-arrow notation. Any new `def`/`theorem` in this file needing a genuine function-type arrow (e.g. `Atom \u2295 Atom \u2192 Atom`) must avoid writing a bare `\u2192` in the type ascription (it parses as `Proposition.imp`); use parameter-style signatures instead, e.g. `def f (x : A) : B := ...`.

Eliminating a multi-constructor inductive Prop (e.g. `CS5Combined`, 3 constructors) into a Type-sorted goal (e.g. building a `PLift`/`ProofSigHom.axMap` result) via `cases`/`match` is disallowed (large-elimination restriction) even though the analogous single-constructor-source case (`CS5ModalAxiom`, via `h.down`) works fine. Fix: prove the Prop-sorted statement first inside a `have`, then wrap the Prop-valued result in the Type-valued constructor (`PLift.up`/`\u27e8...\u27e9`) outside the `cases`.
